headlines.label: Overtakes
headlines.detail: On track after lap 1 · most: BOR (6)

summary: Max Verstappen won the Azerbaijan Grand Prix from pole position, 14.6s ahead of George Russell, with Carlos Sainz completing the podium.
Alexander Albon made the biggest climb, from P19 to P13.
Fernando Alonso had a day to forget, dropping from P11 to P15.
The race was neutralised by 1 safety car.
The stewards penalised PIA (5 second time penalty), ALO (5 second time penalty) and ALB (10 second time penalty).
There were 21 pit stops in total; the winner stopped once.
Oscar Piastri leads the championship by 25 points over Lando Norris.
